title: Sons and Heirs, Paul's Concern for the Galatians

questions.question: I mean that the heir, as long as he is a child, is no different from a ____, though he is the owner of everything.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:1 (ESV): "I mean that the heir, as long as he is a child, is no different from a slave, though he is the owner of everything,"

questions.question: But when the fullness of time had come, God sent forth his Son, born of woman, born under the law, to ____ those who were under the law.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:4-5 (ESV): "But when the fullness of time had come, God sent forth his Son, born of woman, born under the law, to redeem those who were under the law, so that we might receive adoption as sons."

questions.question: And because you are sons, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, "____! Father!"
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:6 (ESV): "And because you are sons, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, 'Abba! Father!'"

questions.question: So you are no longer a slave, but a son, and if a son, then an ____ through God.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:7 (ESV): "So you are no longer a slave, but a son, and if a son, then an heir through God."

questions.question: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were enslaved to those that by nature are not gods. But now how can you turn back again to the weak and worthless ____?
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:8-9 (ESV): "Formerly, when you did not know God, you were enslaved to those that by nature are not gods... how can you turn back again to the weak and worthless elementary principles of the world, whose slaves you want to be once more?"

questions.question: Paul expresses his concern: "You observe days and months and seasons and ____!"
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:10 (ESV): "You observe days and months and seasons and years!"

questions.question: He fears that perhaps his labor over them has been in ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:11 (ESV): "I am afraid I may have labored over you in vain."

questions.question: Paul reminds them that it was because of a ____ that he preached the gospel to them at first.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:13 (ESV): "You know it was because of a bodily ailment that I preached the gospel to you at first,"

questions.question: When Paul was ill, the Galatians did not scorn or despise him, but received him as an ____ of God, as Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:14 (ESV): "and though my condition was a trial to you, you did not scorn or despise me, but received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus."

questions.question: Paul writes, "For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have gouged out your ____ and given them to me."
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:15 (ESV): "What then has become of your blessedness? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have gouged out your eyes and given them to me."

questions.question: Have I then become your enemy by telling you the ____?
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:16 (ESV): "Have I then become your enemy by telling you the truth?"

questions.question: Paul calls them "my little children, for whom I am again in the anguish of childbirth until ____ is formed in you!"
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:19 (ESV): "my little children, for whom I am again in the anguish of childbirth until Christ is formed in you!"

questions.question: Paul uses an allegory involving Abraham's two sons. The son of the slave woman was born according to the flesh, while the son of the free woman was born through ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:23 (ESV): "But the son of the slave was born according to the flesh, while the son of the free woman was born through promise."

questions.question: The two women represent two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children for slavery; she is ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:24 (ESV): "Now this may be interpreted allegorically: these women are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children for slavery; she is Hagar."

questions.question: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our ____.
questions.explanation: Galatians 4:26 (ESV): "But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother."

key_verse_text: But when the fullness of time had come, God sent forth his Son, born of woman, born under the law, to redeem those who were under the law, so that we might receive adoption as sons.
